groups.definition: Fluctuations in prices of lithium, nickel, cobalt and other battery raw materials raise EV production costs that may not be passed to customers.
Insufficient supply of battery cells and raw materials such as lithium, cobalt and nickel could constrain EV production.
Long development-to-delivery cycles and inventory stockpiling cause high and volatile working capital needs.
Fluctuating prices of metals, resins, energy and components raise costs, mitigated only partly by pass-through provisions and hedging.
Unrealized gains and losses on marketable securities holdings can materially affect reported results.
Investments and offtake agreements with raw material and battery suppliers expose the company to financial loss and supplier sustainability shortcomings.
The market prices of the company's stock and other securities may fluctuate significantly, potentially triggering securities litigation.
